releases.name: v0.1.2 — Collapsed sidebar option and spacing fix
releases.body:
## Changes

- Add `start-closed` option to start the quota sidebar section collapsed.
- Remove extra top padding above the quota sidebar section so spacing matches adjacent OpenCode sections.
- Add verified CI builds and npm trusted publishing workflow.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/m1c1b/opencode-omniroute-quota/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.2

releases.name: v0.1.0 — Initial public release
releases.body:
## Highlights

- OmniRoute account quotas in the OpenCode session sidebar and a dedicated details panel.
- Bar and percentage-only styles, with layouts tested at 32 and 70 columns.
- Weighted 5-hour and 7-day summaries, explicit AGY aggregate groups, and individual quota details.
- Optional pinned provider with preserved account order.
- Cached automatic polling, manual provider refresh, timeout handling, and stale-state reporting.
- Environment-based API keys, masked sidebar labels, and redirect rejection.

## Requirements

- OpenCode 2.1.0 (V2 TUI plugin API).
- An OmniRoute server and a usage-authorized key. Manual refresh requires a management token with manage or admin scope.
- Use HTTPS for remote OmniRoute servers.

## Installation

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/m1c1b/opencode-omniroute-quota#installation) for configuration. The attached npm-format archive contains the built plugin. Version `0.1.0` was unpublished from npm. The GitHub archive remains available. A replacement npm version is being prepared; npm blocks republication of the package name for 24 hours after unpublishing.

## Validation

- Typecheck, complexity lint, and build passed.
- 50 tests passed, including render capture tests.
- Dependency audit reported no known vulnerabilities.

License: Apache-2.0.
